newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN CEMENTMAKER CBR JUMPS ON OPTIMISM.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN CEMENTMAKER CBR JUMPS ON OPTIMISM.

text.p: Shares in leading Belgian cementmaker CBR jumped 2.6 percent on Tuesday with dealers putting it down to investors expecting strong 1996 results, due out this week, and good growth prospects for 1997.

"It is one of the best cement companies in Europe and the company has the characteristic to make good profits on the home market and use the free cash flow to invest in other markets which offer more growth prospects," a trader said.
By 1400 GMT the stock was up 2.65 percent at 3,490 francs, with over 150 million Belgian francs worth of the share traded.
He added that CBR was "playing the cards for an international expansion".
"The share is up because it's a good company, stock markets are booming everywhere and the share has lagged recent rises," said another trader.
Dealers said CBR, which had broken the 3,400 francs resistance level, was now free to climb higher.
CBR is a unit of Germany's Heidelberger Zement .
